a.lede: When (or if) Ring's security camera drone flies into our homes in January, you won't get the option to pilot it yourself. The Ring Drone Cam relies entirely on an "AI Pilot" system to follow pre-programmed routes and navigate autonomously around obstacles, with no manual control option available - and an embarrassing demonstration with CBS […]
a.title: Ring confirms its camera drone won’t have manual controls after crashing on CBS News

b.lede: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.
b.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
